 Olympic figure skater Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov also received two perfect scores in the semifinals. 
 The three-hour finale airs live at 6 p.m. MST on ABC and Disney+ next Tuesday. 
 Five couples made it to the finale. 
 The five finalists for the “Dancing with the Stars” Season 35 finale next week are now set: Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov, Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach, Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold, Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik, and Maura Higgins and Mark Ballas. 
 The five couples made it to the finale after a shocking elimination in the semifinals. 
 During the semifinals, each couple performed two new dances, one ballroom style and one Latin dance style. There was no specific theme for the semifinal songs. 
 The show also announced that next week’s finale will be aired live in all four U.S. time zones. 
 Related A vampire, a wizard, Batman and now Bond: A look at Robert Pattinson’s wild career The season’s top scorer is sent home before the finals
 After getting multiple perfect scores, topping the leaderboard multiple times and earning immunity from last week’s dance-off challenge, actor Harry Shum Jr. and his pro partner Jenna Johnson were sent home last night. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 The shocking elimination came after the couple received two perfect scores for a total of 60 out of 60 points between their two dances. 
 Their Latin dance was a paso doble to “We Found Love” by Rihanna featuring Calvin Harris.
 For their ballroom dance, the pair performed a quickstep to “Valerie” by Mark Ronson featuring Amy Winehouse. 
 “I want to say, you have been dealing with everything with grace, with the noise outside and teaching me the things that I have only dreamed of to learn, and this has been one of the most beautiful experiences, so thank you so much,” Shum told Johnson after their elimination. 
 Related ‘You’re a showman’: Did this Utah singer land in ‘The Voice’ top 10? A look at our 5 finalists
 Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach
 For their ballroom dance, Paralympian Ezra Frech and his pro partner Daniella Karagach performed a quickstep to “Kryptonite” by 3 Doors Down. 
 Score: 27 out of 30
 Their Latin dance was a jive to “Footloose” by Kenny Loggins.
 Score: 30 out of 30
 Total score: 57 out of 60
 Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov
 For their Latin dance, Olympic figure skate Amber Glenn and her pro partner Pasha Pashkov performed a salsa to “Bemba Colorá” by Celia Cruz.
 Score: 30 out of 30
 The couple performed a Viennese waltz to “Dangerous Woman” by Ariana Grande for their ballroom dance.
 Score: 30 out of 30
 Total score: 60 out of 60
 Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold
 Comedian and podcaster Connor Wood and his pro partner Rylee Arnold performed a jive to “Blue Suede Shoes” by Elvis Presley for their Latin dance.
 Score: 24 out of 30
 For their ballroom dance, the pair performed a quickstep to “Dance, Dance” by Fall Out Boy. 
 Score: 24 out of 30
 Total score: 48 out of 60
 Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik
 Actress Tatyana Ali and her pro partner Jan Ravnik’s ballroom dance was a waltz to “Open Arms” by Journey. 
 Score: 27 out of 30
 They also performed a cha-cha to “I Like It Like That” by Pete Rodríguez for their Latin dance.
 Score: 28 out of 30
 Total score: 55 out of 60

 “Love Island” and “The Traitors” star Maura Higgins and her pro partner Mark Ballas performed a samba to “Samba Vocalizado” by Luciano Perrone for their Latin dance. 
 Score: 30 out of 30
 Their ballroom dance was a Viennese waltz to “Shrike” by Hozier.
 View Comments Score: 29 out of 30
 Total score: 59 out of 60
 How to watch the ‘Dancing with the Stars’ finale next week
 For the first time ever, the “Dancing with the Stars” finale will be aired live regardless of time zone. This also allows viewers to all be able to vote. 
 The three-hour finale will air at 6 p.m. MST on Tuesday, Nov. 24, on ABC and Disney+. It will also be available to stream the next day on Hulu.
